label: Directional capacity
subgoals: Identify which layers run across a given gcell boundary
Sum tracks over the layers of that direction
Exclude the pin layer from routing capacity

label: Filling layers bottom-up
subgoals: Order the layers of the needed direction from the bottom
Accumulate capacity until it covers the demand
Recognise overflow when total directional capacity is exceeded

label: Wrong-way wiring
subgoals: Price a wrong-way jog as the factor times its length
Price the alternative as the length plus two vias
Solve for the longest jog that is still cheaper
